items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: At the time you joined Duke, the 12 members of the band were ... Freddie Jenkins ... is that right? Right. Uh-huh.

ctx.x: Freddie Martin was there that early, wasn't he?
He was -- I think the Ambassador, I think he was a little later than some of these others. Freddie
hasn't been out too long, I don't believe. I wouldn't say Freddie's been out over eight years, or more. I really don't know right now.

items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Freddy Jenkins -- he wrote several tunes before he had to leave. And I've never heard anything about what happened to them so I don't know, but everybody, with the exception of the guitar player, used to contribute in the musical side of the aggregation.

ctx.x: How about other members of the band? Who were some of the other composers in the band?

Well, let me see -- Harry Carney, of course Johnny. And Barney, Tricky -- that was Tricky Sam, Cootie and most everybody did something. Freddy Jenkins -- he wrote several tunes before he had to leave. And I've never heard anything about what happened to them so I don't know, but everybody, with the exception of the guitar player, used to contribute in the musical side of the aggregation.
